criteria.literal: Não há transação global presumida nem efeito repetido em retry.

sourceTests.fact: Planner applies while Procurement conflicts; no cross-domain rollback is assumed. Ordered receipts, retries in both orders and dispose/reopen preserve exact producer-call counts.
Durable global attempt blocks same/different-intent and concurrent-actor redispatch across restart; only exact authorized receipt recovery reconciles.

criteria.limit: Own backend/HTTP/provider/real-domain boundaries only. This does not establish every portfolio/native parent route.

criteria.literal: Falha conserva trabalho e estado de cada mudança.

sourceTests.fact: Lost/revoked responses preserve the unrelated concurrent objective edit, the first applied change, the second conflict, ordered receipts and the complete case after dispose/reopen.
Actual Planner and Procurement changes retain distinct applied/conflict states and do not lose the first committed domain result.

Receipt-loss leaves the selected choice and planned change intact, exposes receipt-required and preserves official committed state until receipt restoration; uncertainty is not misreported as success.

criteria.limit: Durable case/proposal work and service projections are established. Unsaved browser form state, installed recovery layout and actual human comprehension remain separate interface requirements; this literal does not itself require claiming them.

criteria.literal: Interfaces são concretas, versões/digests são verificáveis e falhas possuem causa e estado explícitos.

sourceTests.fact: Closed payload admission, real human grants, explicit cause/status and exact case version are exercised at the own HTTP boundary.
Wrong alternative version, forged digest, source revocation, real case CAS and mismatched retry are refused with explicit states while original versioned choice/result remain immutable.

Application-status has concrete not-attempted/receipt-required/reconciled projections; stale case, invalid authority, forbidden payload fields and restricted receipt access return explicit reason and HTTP status without leaking terminal value.
Versioned registry and digests retain immutable history; stale expected version and changed old-intent replay have distinct explicit refusals.

criteria.limit: Concrete own ports/services/HTTP schemas and exercised error states are established, not full installed/native interoperability. W19 still has130 foreign type diagnostics, including a missing type-only factory and a WP01 constructor missing verifyScenarioOperations; zero own diagnostics does not qualify package-wide typecheck.

candidateQualification.method: Original source facts plus explicit per-root identity or symbol review and focused completed H7/E1/E2. Never relabel executions.
